sheet_notes.text: Header: boxed 'RAINBOW PRINTING & OFFICE SUPPLY' (no address/phone/email on this sheet). Title: 'LARGE FORMAT XEROX PRICING' (older sheet).
Pasted strip below header box: 'COLOR SCAN $ 10 FIRST PAGE $5 EACH PAGE AFTER' (paper strip, slightly rotated, edges visible).

Handwritten purple marker: '12.95 Color' above the 24 x 36 line; 'B/W' right of printed $2.50 ea; '15.95 Color' above 30 x 42; '?.95 Color' above 18 x 24 with overwritten first digit (best read 7.95, medium confidence). Handwritten dark ink at bottom: '36 x48 Color' (plum/purple) and '19.95 EA.' (black/slate).

Stray pen mark: one short purple diagonal stroke (about 0.2 in long, leaning like a '1' or tick) directly above the '24' of '18 x 24 copy' (above the right half of '24'), detached from the overwritten price above the $2.00. No evident meaning; not part of any number. Can be read as a handwritten '1' but is not attached to the price.
Footer: 'Otherwise Large format Xerox copies charged at $1.25 per linear foot'. No sales-tax, turnaround, or 'subject to change' statement on this sheet.

Header: 'RAINBOW PRINTING & OFFICE SUPPLY / 917 Tahoe Boulevard, Suite 103 • Incline Village, NV 89451 / 775-831-2276 Phone • 775-831-5535 Fax / www.RainbowOfficeSupply.com • RainbowIncline@gmail.com' with rule underneath (older typeset letterhead, no logo).

Sub-heading: 'Printed Labels White / Black Ink 30 per page Avery 5160'; column headers 'Black Ink' and 'Color Ink'. Note the sub-heading says 'Black Ink' but the table carries both Black Ink and Color Ink columns.
No sales-tax, turnaround, or 'subject to change' text on this sheet. Right/top edge shows gray scan shadow; a few stray dust specks, no handwriting.
Header: 'COMPUTER USAGE SERVICES AND PRICING'. Handwritten gray marker 'Jessica' (name) at top left with a long underline swoosh; it overlaps the left of the title.

Left edge of the scan is cropped on every table/heading at the left: visible text only for section headings ('t from Electronic file', 'N TO Electronic file', 'ER SERVICES:'), row labels ('olor Large format', 'OPY CD/DVD', 'large/Reduce'), partial '(includes 1 CD)', 'cument feedable)', and the COLOR COPIES Size column ('ze', '...11', '...14', '17').
Pasted printed strip 'COLOR SCAN $ 10 FIRST PAGE $5 EACH PAGE AFTER' lies across the Color Large format row of the SCAN TO Electronic file table (slightly rotated, overlapping cell borders).
Blue handwritten arrow and text '<- Versant 180' to the right of the 8.5x11~11x17 scan row, arrow pointing left into the row (a cross-stroked 't').

Section headings (Print from Electronic file, SCAN TO Electronic file, OTHER SERVICES:, COLOR COPIES, BLACK/WHITE COPIES, Large Format Color, Large Format B/W, Self Serve Computer) are in red type. Lines '$1.25 per sq ft. otherwise on B/W large format' and 'Copy onto vellum 18x24 ...$3.00 24x36... $6.00' are printed in blue type.

B/W COPIES table: struck/scribbled cells are 8.5x11 single 21-99 (.07) and 100 & up (.08 read); all others are clean. Large Format B/W: 24x36 no acct. $2.50 struck (blue pen) with no replacement; 30x42 no acct. $3.25 struck (pencil scribble) with pencil '350' beside it; 30x42 w/acct $3.00 is NOT struck (grid line crosses the text).
No sales-tax, turnaround, or 'subject to change' text on this sheet.
Title: 'BINDERY PRICES' (older typed sheet; no letterhead/phone). Scan is grayscale only (no colour information), with gray scan shadow along the top and right edges.

Laminating block: printed values for Card size (.75 part), 8.5x11, 8.5x14 and 11x17 are each struck by dense gray scribbles; replacements written in light pencil (8.5x11 '2.00', 8.5x14 '3.00') and, for 11x17, a pencil value that is itself scribbled out followed by pen '4.00'. '24" wide 2.95 per square foot' is untouched.
Unrelated marks: a pencil coil/spiral doodle to the right of the 'Coil-Bind' line; faint gray smudge right of 'Shrink wrapping 1.00 per 500 sheets'; scattered dust specks. None are values.

No sales-tax, turnaround, or 'subject to change' text on this sheet. Sheet is split into two scan strips (top, bottom) that overlap at the Spiral Binding / Coil-Bind lines; overlapping lines recorded once.
Header: Rainbow logo; 'PRINTING & OFFICE SUPPLY'; '(775) 831-2276 • FAX (775) 831-5535'; '917 TAHOE BLVD., SUITE 103 • BOX 5488 • INCLINE VILLAGE, NV 89451'.
Red heading: 'Prices for Printing / Business Cards U.S Sizes / 3.5” x 2” or 2” x 3.5” Any other size requires a special quote.'

No added/removed text, no handwriting, no price differences.
